professional_summary.content: Sabrina (chronological age: 10 months) was assessed using multiple standardized pediatric assessment tools to evaluate developmental functioning across cognitive, motor, sensory processing, language, and social-emotional domains. The comprehensive evaluation revealed both areas of emerging developmental skills and areas requiring targeted intervention support, particularly in fine motor coordination, attention and focus, and communication skills. Her emerging strengths include social engagement and a strong potential for learning, underscoring her ability to benefit from targeted therapeutic interventions. Based on the assessment findings, occupational therapy services are recommended to address her identified developmental needs and enhance her functional performance in daily activities. A multidisciplinary, family-centered approach involving occupational therapy, speech-language therapy, and potential early childhood intervention services will be beneficial in addressing her comprehensive developmental needs. This assessment provides a foundation for developing an individualized intervention plan that will include family education and be designed to enhance Sabrina's developmental outcomes. Regular monitoring and reassessment will be crucial to track her progress and to refine intervention strategies to maximize her potential for developmental success.
